STRICT PROTOCOL: 1. PHASE 1 (Memory Scan): Review all the information you have about me (hobbies, profession, core values, mission, strengths, and daily routine). 2. PHASE 2 (The Gatekeeper): You ARE NOT ALLOWED to generate any image yet. You must first stop and ask me to upload a clear portrait photo of myself. 3. Apply deep Ambient Occlusion shadows behind every note and object to create a strong physical 3D depth (making them appear raised from the background). Notes must be "physically attached" using detailed 3D props: metallic binder clips, push-pins, paperclips, or safety pins. COMPOSITION STRUCTURE (RTL Hebrew Text): Central Character: A full-body 3D likeness based on my uploaded photo, dressed in attire that reflects my personality/profession. Inset Photo: A clean circular frame in the corner showing the original photo, with a 3D arrow pointing to the character. Floating Notes (Hebrew Titles, Right-to-Left): "השליחות שלי": My core mission/purpose. "בליבה שלי": My top 5 personality traits with 3D props. "דברים שאני אוהב": My hobbies/interests with detailed 3D icons. "החוזקות שלי": My professional/personal strengths with unique 3D icons (Brain, Star, etc.). "הוייב היומי": 3 physical Polaroid-style snapshots showing my daily routine with captions. Background: A serene, natural landscape that complements the color palette. Foreground: Scattered 3D props related to my life (e.g., tools, books, gadgets) with realistic shadows. MANDATORY WATERMARK: Include the Hebrew text "תוכן שהופק על ידי בינה מלאכותית" clearly at the bottom center. Confirm you have scanned my memory and ask me for my photo to begin.
